maddeler.e: لَا تَجْعَلِ الحَبّةَ قُبّة • (lā tajʕali l-ḥabbata qubba)
maddeler.t: Literally "do not make a grain into a dome", each being a metaphor for something small and something large, respectively.
g: one should not exaggerate or make a scene of trivial matters.
one should not allow minor problems or disagreements to snowball.
